47709-harper-s-young-people-june-14-1881.title: Harper S Young People June 14 1881 An Illustrated Weekly
47709-harper-s-young-people-june-14-1881.creator: Unknown
47709-harper-s-young-people-june-14-1881.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Some boys are afraid that they will fall while learning to ride, and therefore don't _dare_ try. Such boys will never learn, nor do we want any cowards among our wheelmen. Of course there must be some falls, and some little danger attends the sport; but no more boys are hurt in learning to ride or in riding a bicycle than by foot-ball, base-ball, cricket, lacrosse, horseback-riding, or a dozen other manly sports in which boys always have engaged and always will.

arxiv-2102-09560.title: A Latent Space Model for Multilayer Network Data bbetancourt@ufl.edu
arxiv-2102-09560.creator: Juan Sosa, Universidad Nacional de Colombia, Colombia
arxiv-2102-09560.description: Abstract In this work, we propose a Bayesian statistical model to simultaneously characterize two or more social networks defined over a common set of actors. The key feature of the model is a hierarchical prior distribution that allows us to represent the entire system jointly, achieving a compromise between dependent and independent networks.

arxiv-2107-03251.title: IRS-Aided WPCNs: A New Optimization Framework for Dynamic IRS Beamforming
arxiv-2107-03251.creator: Qingqing Wu, Xiaobo Zhou, Wen Chen, Jun Li, and Xiuyin Zhang
arxiv-2107-03251.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Qingqing Wu, Xiaobo Zhou, Wen Chen, Jun Li, and Xiuyin Zhang. In this paper, we propose a new dynamic IRS beamforming framework to boost the sum throughput of an intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) aided wireless powered communication network (WPCN). Specifically, the IRS phase-shift vectors across time and resource allocation are jointly optimized to enhance the efficiencies of both downlink wireless power transfer (DL WPT) and uplink wireless information transmission (UL WIT) between a hybrid access point (HAP) and multiple wirelessly powered devices.

arxiv-2108-04877.title: Analysis note: jet reconstruction, energy spectra, and substructure analyses with archived ALEPH data
arxiv-2108-04877.creator: Yi Chen, Yen-Jie Lee, Marcello Maggi, Paoti Chang, Yang-Ting Chien, Christopher McGinn, Dennis Perepelitsa
arxiv-2108-04877.description: Abstract The first measurements of anti- k T k_{T} jet energy spectrum and substructure in hadronic Z Z decays are presented. The archived e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} annihilation data at a center-of-mass energy of 91 GeV were collected with the ALEPH detector at LEP in 1994. The jet substructure was analyzed as a function of jet energy.

arxiv-2207-00356.title: On Drell-Yan production of scalar leptoquarks coupling to heavy-quark flavours
arxiv-2207-00356.creator: Ulrich Haisch, Luc Schnell, and Stefan Schulte
arxiv-2207-00356.description: Abstract Given the hints of lepton-flavour non-universality in semi-leptonic B B decays, leptoquark (LQ) models with sizeable couplings to heavy-quark flavours are enjoying a renaissance. While such models are subject to stringent constraints from low-energy experiments also bounds from non-resonant dilepton searches at the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) turn out to be phenomenologically relevant.

arxiv-2208-06326.title: Sparse change detection in high-dimensional linear regression
arxiv-2208-06326.creator: Fengnan Gao and Tengyao Wang
arxiv-2208-06326.description: Abstract We introduce a new methodology ‘ charcoal ’ for estimating the location of sparse changes in high-dimensional linear regression coefficients, without assuming that those coefficients are individually sparse. The procedure works by constructing different sketches (projections) of the design matrix at each time point, where consecutive projection matrices differ in sign in exactly one column.

arxiv-2303-07154.title: Differentiable Good Arm Identification
arxiv-2303-07154.creator: Yun-Da Tsai, Tzu-Hsien Tsai, Shou-De Lin
arxiv-2303-07154.description: Abstract This paper focuses on a variant of the stochastic multi-armed bandit problem known as good arm identification (GAI). GAI is a pure-exploration bandit problem that aims to identify and output as many good arms as possible using the fewest number of samples. A good arm is defined as an arm whose expected reward is greater than a given threshold.

arxiv-2404-16761.title: Hydrogen storage in pristine and Janus transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers: electronic origins, coverage effects, and finite-temperature stability
arxiv-2404-16761.creator: Flávio Bento de Oliveira 1, Gabriel Elyas Gama Araújo 1 and Andreia Luisa da Rosa 1
arxiv-2404-16761.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Flávio Bento de Oliveira 1, Gabriel Elyas Gama Araújo 1 and Andreia Luisa da Rosa 1. Hydrogen adsorption and storage in two-dimensional transition-metal dichalcogenides are governed by a subtle interplay between electronic structure, lattice geometry, and surface chemistry. Here, we present a systematic first-principles study of hydrogen adsorption on pristine and Janus MX 2 and MSSe monolayers (M = Ni, Pd, Pt; X = S, Se), combining density-functional theory calculations with finite-temperature ab initio molecular dynamics simulations.

arxiv-2601-13651.creator: Marta Moscati 1 , Oleksandr Kats 1 , Mubashir Noman 2 , Muhammad Zaigham Zaheer 2 Yufang Hou 3 , Markus Schedl 1,4 , Shah Nawaz 1
arxiv-2601-13651.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Marta Moscati 1 , Oleksandr Kats 1 , Mubashir Noman 2 , Muhammad Zaigham Zaheer 2 Yufang Hou 3 , Markus Schedl 1,4 , Shah Nawaz 1. Face-voice association is widely studied in multimodal learning and is approached representing faces and voices with embeddings that are close for a same person and well separated from those of others. Previous work achieved this with loss functions.

pmc-10485062.title: Monitoring of carbon-water fluxes at Eurasian meteorological stations using random forest and remote sensing
pmc-10485062.creator: Mingjuan Xie, Xiaofei Ma, Yuangang Wang, Chaofan Li, Haiyang Shi, Xiuliang Yuan, Olaf Hellwich, Chunbo Chen, Wenqiang Zhang, Chen Zhang, Qing Ling, Ruixiang Gao, Yu Zhang, Friday Uchenna Ochege, Amaury Frankl, Philippe De Maeyer, Nina Buchmann, Iris Feigenwinter, Jørgen E Olesen, Radoslaw Juszczak,
pmc-10485062.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Simulating the carbon-water fluxes at more widely distributed meteorological stations based on the sparsely and unevenly distributed eddy covariance flux stations is needed to accurately understand the carbon-water cycle of terrestrial ecosystems. We established a new framework consisting of machine learning, determination coefficient (R2), Euclidean distance, and remote sensing (RS), to simulate the daily net ecosystem carbon dioxide exchange (NEE) and water flux (WF) of the Eurasian meteorological stations using a random forest model or/and RS.

pmc-10542266.title: Development of the “living well” concept for older people with dementia
pmc-10542266.creator: Jiyoung Kim, Nayeon Shin
pmc-10542266.description: BackgroundAn important goal in dementia care is how people with dementia can be supported in living well. To this end, we need a conceptualization of “living well” that is suitable for older people with dementia and then develop this conceptualization from the perspectives of both older people and caregivers.

pmc-10599213.title: Analyzing the Performance of ChatGPT About Osteoporosis
pmc-10599213.creator: Cigdem Cinar
pmc-10599213.description: Introduction: This study evaluates the knowledge of ChatGPT about osteoporosis.Methods: Osteoporosis-related frequently asked questions (FAQs) created by examining the websites frequently visited by patients, the official websites of hospitals, and social media. Questions based on these scientific data have been prepared in accordance with National Osteoporosis Guideline Group guides.

pmc-10706530.title: Prevalence and social determinants associated with oral cancer in Al-Baha Region of Saudi Arabia: A seven-year retrospective cohort hospital-based study
pmc-10706530.creator: Abdullah Ali H. Alzahrani
pmc-10706530.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background:The region of Al-Baha area of interest is associated with risk factors; yet no research in the literature has explored oral cancer (OC) and its associated social determinants and risk factors in this region. The aim of this study was to access the prevalence of OC in the Al-Baha region and its association with the social determinants and risk factors in this population.Methods:A retrospective cohort hospital-based study was conducted in Al-Baha Region between January 2012 and December 2019.

pmc-10711196.title: Is polio making a comeback? The cost of vaccine hesitancy and the disparity in vaccine coverage

However, the oral polio vaccine (OPV), developed in 1962, is now the most used vaccine to prevent the disease (Thompson, 2022[19]), containing live-attenuated poliovirus.

pmc-11452236.title: KL-6 Mucin as Serum Tumor Marker of Metastatic Renal Cancer: A Case Report
pmc-11452236.creator: Kyohei Ishida, Go Hasegawa, Toshinori Takada, Akira Ogose, Gen Kawaguchi, Yohei Ikeda, Hiroki Nishiyama, Noboru Hara, Tsutomu Nishiyama
pmc-11452236.description: We encountered a case of metastatic renal cell carcinoma in which the serum level of KL-6, a therapeutic marker, was exceptionally high and fluctuated with the progression of treatment. A 74-year-old man was diagnosed with right renal cystic cancer and multiple metastases in October 2022. The KL-6 level was 27490 U/mL. He started treatment with lenvatinib and pembrolizumab.

pmc-11474687.description: BackgroundThe nationwide HUN-CANCER EPI study examined cancer incidence and mortality rates in Hungary from 2011 to 2019.MethodsUsing data from the National Health Insurance Fund (NHIF) and Hungarian Central Statistical Office (HCSO), our retrospective study analyzed newly diagnosed malignancies between Jan 1, 2011, and Dec 31, 2019.

pmc-11484059.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). pmc-11504140.title: Mycobacteriophages and Their Applications
pmc-11504140.creator: Andrea Bonacorsi, Caterina Ferretti, Mariagrazia Di Luca, Laura Rindi, Adelaide Almeida
pmc-11504140.description: Mycobacterial infections caused by tuberculous and non-tuberculous strains pose significant treatment challenges, especially among immunocompromised patients. Conventional antibiotic therapies often fail due to bacterial resistance, highlighting the need for alternative therapeutic strategies. Mycobacteriophages are emerging as promising candidates for the treatment of mycobacteria. This review comprehensively explores phage isolation, characterization, and clinical applications.

pmc-11607629.title: Cysteine‐rich 61 inhibition attenuates hepatic insulin resistance and improves lipid metabolism in high‐fat diet fed mice and HepG2 cells
pmc-11607629.creator: Yu Jung Heo, Jieun Park, Nami Lee, Sung‐E Choi, Ja Young Jeon, Seung Jin Han, Dae Jung Kim, Kwan Woo Lee, Hae Jin Kim
pmc-11607629.description: Metabolic dysfunction‐associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is strongly associated with insulin resistance development. Hepatic lipid accumulation and inflammation are considered the main drivers of hepatic insulin resistance in MASLD. Cysteine‐rich 61 (Cyr61 also called CCN1), a novel secretory matricellular protein, is implicated in liver inflammation, and its role in MASLD is not clearly understood.

pmc-11674951.title: Attempts to Create Transgenic Mice Carrying the Q3924E Mutation in RyR2 Ca2+ Binding Site
pmc-11674951.creator: Xiao-hua Zhang, Fu-lei Tang, Allison M. Trouten, Martin Morad
pmc-11674951.description: Over 200 point mutations in the ryanodine receptor (RyR2) of the cardiac sarcoplasmic reticulum (SR) are known to be associated with cardiac arrhythmia. We have already reported on the calcium signaling phenotype of a point mutation in RyR2 Ca2+ binding site Q3925E expressed in human stem-cell-derived cardiomyocytes (hiPSC-CMs) that was found to be lethal in a 9-year-old girl.

pmc-11996125.title: The Association between EPHX1 Gene Polymorphisms and Lung Cancer among Jordanian People
pmc-11996125.creator: Tamara E Al-Qudah, Said Ismail, Dana Abdeen, Nidaa A Ababneh, Faisal Khatib, Mohamed K Al-Essa, Feras Hawari, Nathir Obeidat, Nabil J Alkayed, Yanal Shafagoj
pmc-11996125.description: Objective:Genetic susceptibility to lung cancer is the subject of extensive research. We investigated whether polymorphisms in the microsomal epoxide hydrolase (EPHX1) gene is linked to lung cancer susceptibility in Jordanian patients. Methods: In this case-control study a total of 218 subjects from Jordan University Hospital and King Hussein Cancer Center were screened (108 lung cancer patients and 110 matched controls).

pmc-12448298.title: Follicular non-Hodgkin lymphoma recurrence in an uncommon site: the lacrimal caruncle
pmc-12448298.creator: Emirhan Ozkul, Mehmet Serhat Mangan, Ibrahım Bulent Buttanri, Seda Mazmanoglu Atilman
pmc-12448298.description: Recurrent follicular lymphoma in the caruncle is an exceedingly rare clinical presentation, with limited cases documented in the literature. This case describes a 58-year-old male with a history of follicular non-Hodgkin lymphoma localized solely to the left caruncle, treated with systemic R-Bendamustine chemotherapy and achieving complete remission.

pmc-12847934.title: GBP2 condensates promote ferroptosis to sensitize anti-PD-L1 immunotherapy in melanoma
pmc-12847934.creator: Xin Liu, Shilin Fang, Xianghai Ren, Yuntian Hong, Jianchun Guo, Xiaoping Liu, Liping Gao, Haihang Nie, Yumei Ning, Meng Zhang, Fei Xu, Lan Liu, Jun Fang, Yu Pang, Qiu Zhao, Fan Wang, Haizhou Wang
pmc-12847934.description: The mechanisms underlying the limited response to immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) remain unclear. One explanation is that tumors escape cytotoxic T cell killing by disrupting interferon-gamma (IFN-γ) signaling. Here we show that guanylate-binding protein 2 (GBP2), an IFN-γ–inducible molecule, functions as a general amplifier of T cell–mediated cytotoxicity by promoting ferroptosis in melanoma.

pmc-13057224.title: Human-centered design-based lightweight wearable IMU human pose estimation
pmc-13057224.creator: Lidong Wang, Juanjuan Liu, Jingxuan Xue, Qinyu Tan, Minmin Li
pmc-13057224.description: We present a wearable IMU–based human pose estimation framework that couples knowledge distillation with an involution–based student and a principled structural re–parameterization for on–device deployment. A high–capacity Transformer serves as the teacher to learn rich temporal–spatial representations, while the student adopts input–adaptive involution operators.

pmc-13367891.title: A ligandable PNT domain establishes ERG as a directly targetable oncogenic driver in prostate cancer
pmc-13367891.creator: Xiaoju Wang, Wenyan Liu, Jiehao Yang, Jean Ching-Yi Tien, Yu Chang, Rahul Mannan, Somnath Mahapatra, Yang Zhou, Lihao Gan, Xuhong Cao, Jiayi Zhou, Yuping Zhang, Sharpkate Shaker, Yichao Huang, Hang Qiao, Rudana Hamadeh, Grafton Ervine, Cynthia Wang, Fengyun Su, Rui Wang, Lanbo Xiao, Raghunath Ranga
pmc-13367891.description: SignificanceThe TMPRSS2:ERG gene fusion is the most common oncogenic driver in prostate cancer, yet the ERG transcription factor has long been considered undruggable due to the absence of known ligand-binding sites. This study overturns that paradigm by identifying a structurally defined, ligandable pocket within the ERG N-terminal Pointed (PNT) domain.

pmc-13451972.title: Health and Health Care Access Among Afghan Refugee Women in the United States
pmc-13451972.creator: Nazineen Kandahari, Nilufar N. Kayhani, Fareha Moulana Zada, Zahra Kayhani, Zarin Noor, Nicholas Nelson, Susan L. Ivey
pmc-13451972.description: This qualitative study uses semistructured interviews to identify key issues associated with health and health care access among Afghan refugee women residing in the United States. Introduction Afghans are one of the world’s largest forcibly displaced populations, with 11 million Afghans forced from their homes, the majority being women and children.
